items.reason: Same agent spelled two ways. The record first writes it in the official title ('Anti-GITR Agonist INCAGN1876') and later as 'INCAGN01876'. Manual §3 says to use the development code 'exactly as first written in the record'. The candidate set is the same in substance.

Inclusion accepts 'WHO grade IV glioblastoma' by histology without an IDH requirement and explicitly allows 'secondary GBM' from prior low-grade glioma. IDH-wildtype is required only on the cIMPACT-NOW molecular route, so the record does not require IDH-wildtype for all entrants (not cns5). This fits C8 'historical'.
Inclusion 5 requires only that 'MGMT methylation status must be available', with no required value; D31-A8 codes this as testing (exploratory_correlative).
Cohort B is for 'evaluation of the effects on the tumor immune microenvironment', but no assay or outcome is described (registered outcomes are ORR, AEs, OS, PFS).

note: (1) The agent dictionary must map incagn1876 and incagn01876 to the same moiety; if XL prefers the registered intervention name, use incagn01876. (2) MGMT 'must be available' is testing under D31-A8, so any_molecular_selection false (as proposed) is now settled. (3) target_engagement_planned set to unclear under D31-C6.

revisions.reason: Inclusion 5: MGMT status 'must be available from any prior GBM tumor specimen', with no required value.
The Cohort B tumour immune-microenvironment objective is stated, but no measurement is described and no PD outcome is registered.
